sourceText:
Cucumber and Red Onion Salad
By: Marisa Mcclellan
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:47pm

Ingredients




1 english cucumber, cut into quarters and chopped
1/4 red onion, thinly slivered
3 tablespoons red wine vinegar
4 tablespoons olive oil
pinch of white sugar

1 teaspoon dried dill, crushed between your fingers
sprinkle of garlic powder 

2 large pinches of kosher salt
6 grinds black pepper

Preparation

1 Chop the veggies and dump them in a bowl. Pour everything else on top and stir it to combine. Taste it a few minutes later and adjust the flavors a bit, if necessary. Then I let it sit until dinner time.

About


This is a slightly enhanced version of a salad I grew up eating for dinner. It was one of my mother's go-to, weeknight salads and she served it with everything from roast chicken to tuna salad. It's quick, easy and also tastes wonderful on sandwiches the next day. 
You can find out more about this recipe at http://www.foodinjars.com/2009/04/16/cucumber-and-red-onion-salad/.

Comments:
Melissa Peterman

Great recipe! I love the tip about using it on sandwiches!
